correctness.rationale: For Q4 (16 vertices, 32 edges) a retained forest inequality 32-4|S|+e(S)<=15-|S| rules out |S|<6. Parity-neighbor overlap shows a six-set cannot be mixed, and the only valid pure parity sets omit one antipodal pair, giving eight minima. An independently written 2^16-mask forest test (union-find on Hamming-one edges) enumerated exactly 8,1008,4090 valid sets at sizes 6,7,8, found 80+9072 toggle edges and the 8-star+928-isolate capacity-seven decomposition; capacity eight has one component of all 5106 states. BFS over all 8 minima gave precisely 12 same-parity pairs at distance 4 and 16 opposite-parity pairs at 12. This exhausts every relevant 16-vertex set and never extrapolates to higher-dimensional cubes.

final_claim: The Q4 cube has exactly eight minimum feedback sets of size six. The capacity-seven one-vertex-add/delete reconfiguration graph is eight K_{1,10} components plus 928 isolated vertices, while the capacity-eight graph is connected with 5106 vertices, 9152 edges and all min-pair distances exactly 4 (same parity) or 12 (opposite parity).
